title.zh: 【渣打银行在阿联酋推出加密货币交易服务，已获得阿联酋虚拟资产监管局许可】
title.en: 【渣打银行在阿联酋推出加密货币交易服务，已获得阿联酋虚拟资产监管局许可】

current_state.zh: Standard Chartered launched a VARA-licensed crypto trading service for eligible professional investors in the UAE, allowing clients to buy and sell Bitcoin and Ethereum directly through existing bank accounts with end-to-end custody and settlement via Zodia Markets, with plans to expand to other markets.
current_state.en: Standard Chartered launched a VARA-licensed crypto trading service for eligible professional investors in the UAE, allowing clients to buy and sell Bitcoin and Ethereum directly through existing bank accounts with end-to-end custody and settlement via Zodia Markets, with plans to expand to other markets.
